messages:
marta: Quick capture from today's Q&A 5 min thread: list wins/losses and top asks leadership should action. Keep it tight.

raj: Sales recap: lost two mid-market deals because buyers wanted a managed VPC connector and faster onboarding timelines. One competitor offered a turn-key private path.

alisa: CS: wins = console observability and per-route cost visibility. Several renewals cited the dashboard and token-level breakdown as differentiators.

devin: Engineering hears repeated requests for a single terraform module + network checklist for Private. Customers are piecing together peering, NATs, and security groups.

nico: Can product commit to what in 30/60/90 days? We need concrete collateral for renewals.

emily: Proposed slate: (30d) security 1-pager for infra teams; (45d) private quickstart with terraform example; (45d) dedicated autoscale guide.

raj: Sales also wants a 1-page tech sheet on data residency/KMS/audit logs to hand to security reviewers. Short, technical bullet points.

alisa: Another ask: embedding cost examples using batching and quantization. Customers want sample cost for 10M embeddings/month with different configs.

devin: I can prototype a cost-calc spreadsheet and a small sample config showing batching+cache effects. Will post a draft to #devex by EOW if scoped.

emily: Important: customers complained about silent model fallbacks. They prefer explicit failure or a notice with opt-out. Need an enterprise-friendly default and fallback logging.

nico: Agree. We should add fallback telemetry + a fallback policy flag. Product + Eng to prioritize.

ops-bot: Created issue AH-4609 "All-hands: customer win/loss followups" assigned to marta, devin, alisa. Link: https://issues.internal/AH-4609

marta: Thanks 5 everyone. I'll create GH issues, set owners, and check back in two weeks. Drop any short customer quotes or collateral links here.
